title: panels are not restored correctly when restoring saved global theme
line: Applying a saved global theme puts each panel back on the screen it was saved on, instead of all on one screen.
explanation: A saved global theme stores each panel's screen as lastScreen in its config, but loadSerializedLayout() created every panel through ShellCorona::addPanel(), which puts it on the active screen, and only wrote the saved lastScreen into the config without moving the panel. So all panels came back on one screen (and only jumped to their saved screen after a plasmashell restart). The change reads the saved lastScreen and, if that screen is connected, moves the panel there with the existing setScreen() before the rest of the panel setup.

commits.message:
scripting: restore a serialized panel on its saved screen

loadSerializedLayout() created every panel through addPanel(), which
puts it on the active screen, so a saved global theme brought all of its
panels back on one screen. Move each panel to its saved lastScreen first.

BUG: 514584

media.caption: Master, two screens: after applying the saved theme the top panel that was on the right screen comes back on the left one; the right screen has no panel
With the fix: the top panel is back on the right screen, the bottom panel on the left one
